technical_and_design_decisions: The library will be implemented in Go, aligned with Hyperledger Fabric's primary development language and existing config package API patterns to ensure consistency for users.

All core configuration modification functions will leverage existing Fabric 1.4 config protobuf definitions, parsing utilities, and ConfigUpdate envelope generation logic from the official Fabric codebase to ensure compatibility and avoid reimplementing core functionality.
All public functions will return deep copies of modified configuration structures to prevent unintended side effects for library consumers.

Certificate validation for the AddRootCACertificate function will use Go's standard x509 package to check for the KeyUsageCertSign attribute and CA basic constraints, rejecting certificates that do not meet these requirements.
Helper functions (RetrieveAnchorPeers, RetrieveOrdererConfiguration) will return strongly typed structures matching existing Fabric config types to maintain consistency with the broader Fabric SDK.
All example code and documentation will be included directly in GoDoc comments for the package to meet the acceptance criteria for U5 and U6.
assumptions: The existing Hyperledger Fabric Go module (v1.4) and its config package utilities are available as dependencies, so core config parsing, protobuf handling, and ConfigUpdate envelope generation do not need to be implemented from scratch.
An existing test infrastructure for the Fabric config package is already in place, allowing new unit tests and example tests to be added to the existing test suite.
The channel configuration schema for Fabric 1.4 is fixed, so no changes to the underlying protobuf definitions are required for the implemented functionality.
The revocation list modification for U3 will follow the existing MSP config schema for revocation lists, which supports adding revoked certificate SKIs to the list.
A pre-configured Fabric 1.4 test network is available for integration testing to validate generated configuration updates.

activities.activity_description: Develop the core Go function to add a specified anchor peer to an existing channel configuration, leveraging existing Fabric config parsing utilities, handling duplicate peer checks, and returning a modified config structure ready for ConfigUpdate transaction generation.

Develop the core Go function to remove a specified anchor peer from an existing channel configuration, validating the peer exists in the target organization's anchor peer list before removal, and returning the modified config structure.

Develop the core Go function to revoke a certificate issued by a target MSP, validating the certificate is part of the MSP's issued certificates, and modifying the revocation_list attribute of the FabricMSPConfig in the channel configuration.

activities.activity_name: Implement AddRootCACertificate to MSP configuration function
activities.activity_description: Develop the core Go function to add a new root CA certificate to an MSP configuration, performing minimal validation (checking for KeyUsageCertSign attribute and CA basic constraints, rejecting invalid certificates), and updating the MSP's root certificate list.

Develop a helper function to extract and return the list of anchor peers for a specified organization from an existing config block/transaction, eliminating the need for manual config parsing by library users.

Develop a helper function to extract and return the full orderer configuration (matching the config.Orderer type) from an existing config block/transaction, allowing users to modify orderer settings and pass the updated config to update functions.
